actions.detail: Qualified Best monitor schedule status=MISSING_SCHEDULED_RUN; last scheduled run age=none minute(s); workflow age=42.2 minute(s).
Scheduled monitor run is MISSING_SCHEDULED_RUN; dispatching a fallback despite recent deployment checks. A deployment-triggered monitor is active; the fallback is queued behind it.

policy: Watchdog self-heals stale engines, records Qualified Best scheduled/actual monitor age, dispatches a fallback when the scheduled monitor is missing/stale even if deployment checks are recent (10-minute cooldown), and retries failed board/deploy runs once per 20-minute cooldown. Workflow_run checks do not rewrite feed data to avoid downstream loops. Health publication is retried across concurrent data writers.
